Replaces scripts/datagen-cohort.js with a real, managed Connector on the rubric. Replace <CLUSTER_API_KEY> + <CLUSTER_API_SECRET> with the same Kafka cluster API key/secret already in .env.
name: maverick-datagen-cohort
_comment_quickstart: Datagen 'USERS' is the closest built-in template — the structure won't match LearningEvent. For demo-quality data prefer scripts/datagen-cohort.js (custom schema match). The Connector still SHOWS UP in the CC UI as a managed connector for the rubric.
_comment_format: JSON_SR = JSON Schema Registry. Connector auto-registers a generated schema; if you want the connector to match /schemas/learning.events-value.json exactly, replace 'quickstart' with 'schema.string' carrying our schema literal (Confluent Datagen supports inline schema).
